verdict: Local Chrome run failed: one likely product bug (quantity not clamped to stock), one WAF 403 block, and two navigation timeouts that passed on retry.

failures.test: Product info › quantity cannot go above the stock of the selected variant
failures.summary: Typing 99 and blurring leaves the quantity at 99 instead of clamping to the 12 in stock for Sage/S; it failed on both attempts.
failures.evidence: Expected: "12" Received: "99"; snapshot shows textbox "Quantity": "99" with paragraph "12 In Stock" and button "Increase quantity" [disabled], so the stepper knows the limit but the input is not clamped.
failures.next_step: Check the quantity-stepper__input blur/change handler, which should clamp typed values to the selected variant's stock (12 for Sage S). Confirm the intended behaviour with product before changing the test.

failures.test: Product info › Add to Cart updates the header basket badge
failures.summary: The page load was blocked by a security policy (403), so the basket button never rendered.
failures.evidence: lastNavigation status 403; snapshot: heading "Access denied" and "Your request was blocked by the security policy."
failures.next_step: Find which WAF or security middleware in front of localhost:3100 returned the 403, likely rate limiting from repeated test requests. Allowlist the test runner or relax the rule for the test environment, then rerun.

failures.test: Smoke: site health › home page renders with site chrome
failures.summary: The initial page.goto timed out at 30s and the test passed on retry.
failures.evidence: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded. navigating to "http://localhost:3100/", waiting until "load"; outcome flaky, attempts 2
failures.next_step: Check whether the local server is slow on first requests (cold start or build). Add a warm-up request or health-check wait before the suite starts.

failures.test: Product info › sizes that are out of stock for the colour are disabled
failures.summary: page.goto in beforeEach timed out and the test passed on retry; this is the same load slowness as the smoke test, with no sign of a defect.
failures.evidence: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded at productPage.gotoProduct (line 5); snapshot after retry shows a normal product page with status 200.
failures.next_step: Handle this together with the smoke timeout: warm up the server, or wait for 'domcontentloaded' instead of 'load' if a slow third-party resource is delaying the load event.
